DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋がぬれたというご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your inquiry about a wet bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。冷たい容器の外に水があります。中の物が漏れたと思いましたが、まだふたは開けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外の水から漏れを疑うが未開封だと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There's water on the outside of the cold container. I thought the contents had leaked, but haven't opened the lid yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that outside water made you suspect leakage but the container is unopened.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外側の状態を確認します。袋の中にほかの商品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the outside condition. Are there other products in the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パンがあります。パンの包装はぬれていますが、中までぬれたかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同袋のパンは外包装だけ濡れていると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Bread. Its wrapping is wet, but I don't know whether the inside is wet too.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that only the outer wrapping of the bread in the same bag is known to be wet.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 容器とパンを別々に確認しましょう。ご自身で開けたり拭き取ったりせず見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the container and bread separately. Please show them without opening or wiping them yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。水だけで、冷たい物の中身がこぼれたと決めずに状態を見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水と内容物の漏れを断定せず現物確認を受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll have the actual condition checked rather than decide from water alone that the cold item's contents spilled.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will have the item checked without assuming water means the contents leaked.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入記録はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have the purchase record?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このレシートです。袋へ入れたのは自分で、いつから水が付いたかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入記録と自己袋詰めと発生時刻の不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: This receipt. I bagged them myself, and didn't see when the water first appeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the purchase record, self-bagging and unknown onset time in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経緯も含めて担当者へ確認します。移し替える袋の用意も相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check with the person responsible including that history. We can also discuss preparing another bag for transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。水の原因と商品の状態を分けて確認し、その案内に従って持ち帰り方を変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原因判断と商品状態と持帰り方法を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I'll check the cause of the water separately from product condition, and change how I take them home according to the guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the cause, product condition and carrying method as separate matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当を呼びます。現物とレシートをこちらへお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll call the staff. Please show the items and receipt here.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知に書かれた方はお父様ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your father the person named on the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ家で暮らすので、私の給与も父の収入として一緒に話せばよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居家族の通知へ自分の給与を合算しようとしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Since we live in the same house, I thought I should include my salary too as part of his income when explaining.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you were going to combine your salary with the information for a co-resident family member's notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 誰のどの期間の情報か分けて確認します。通知の対象期間は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check whose information it is and which period separately. Can you read the notice's covered period?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 読めます。父のその期間の資料と、私の最近の給与を混ぜて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象者と期間の違う資料を混ぜたと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I brought his documents for that period mixed with my recent salary documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you mixed documents for different people and periods.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 資料を分けてください。お父様から相談を依頼されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please separate them. Has your father asked you to seek advice?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相談先を調べてと言われただけです。私が父に代わって内容を決める依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 依頼は相談先調査で内容決定の代理ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: He only asked me to find out where to ask. He didn't ask me to decide the details on his behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the request was to find an advice contact, not to act as decision-maker.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その範囲で相談方法をご案内します。本人の相談や代理の条件は別に担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain how to ask within that scope. Separately check personal consultation and proxy conditions with staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は必要な準備を聞き、父の収入を自分の給与で補って説明しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 準備相談に絞り他人の収入を自己給与で補わないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Today I'll ask about preparations and won't use my salary to fill in an explanation of my father's income.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will limit this to preparation advice and not substitute your salary for another person's income.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通知と対応する資料について、確認する質問を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's organize questions to check about the notice and corresponding documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。対象者、対象期間、本人が用意する物の三点を聞いて父へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象者期間必要資料の質問を整理して本人へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll ask three things—whose information, which period and what he needs to prepare—and pass them to my father.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize questions about the person, period and required documents and say in Japanese that you will tell the person concerned.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備についての相談として担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll direct you to staff for a consultation about preparations.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: つけ麺を一人前でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: One serving of dipping noodles, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。汁を飲んでから麺を食べたいので、汁を二杯付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 汁を先に飲むため二杯を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to drink the broth before eating the noodles, so could I have two bowls of broth?
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request two bowls in Japanese because you intend to drink the broth first.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの汁は麺をつけて召し上がるためのものです。まず一人前の内容をご説明しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: This broth is for dipping noodles into as you eat. Shall I first explain what one serving includes?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。普通のスープと同じ量を先に飲む物と思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: つけ汁の用途を普通のスープと誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please. I thought it was like ordinary soup that you drink a full bowl of beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook the dipping broth's purpose for ordinary soup.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では麺とつけ汁を別にお出しします。汁の追加は、食べ始めて必要になった時に相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this scenario, we serve noodles and dipping broth separately. You can ask about extra broth if you need it after starting to eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では最初の二杯の希望は取り消します。麺をつけて食べる一人前でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最初の汁追加を取消して一人前へ戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll cancel my initial request for two bowls. Please give me one serving for dipping the noodles and eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Cancel the initial extra broth request and return to one serving in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。麺の量は通常の量でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Is the normal quantity of noodles all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。汁の二杯を頼んだことは、麺二人前の注文でもありません。麺は一人前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 麺量と汁の個数を独立して確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Asking for two bowls of broth didn't mean ordering two noodle servings either. One serving of noodles.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm noodle quantity separately from the number of broth bowls in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 麺一人前、つけ汁は付属の一つとして受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll take the order as one noodle serving and the one accompanying dipping broth.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。まずその内容で食べて、汁が足りない場合だけ追加の扱いを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 付属汁で始め必要時だけ追加を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll start with that and ask about extra broth only if it isn't enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will start with the included broth and discuss extra only if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でご用意します。追加が必要でしたらお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll prepare that. Please call us if you need more.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの伝票でお会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: We'll charge you using this bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 追加の飲み物がありません。途中で隣の席から移ったので、前の席の伝票に付いたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 席移動後の会計に追加飲料がないと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: The extra drink isn't there. We moved from the neighboring seat partway through, so it may have been added to the previous seat's bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the bill after moving seats lacks your additional drink.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の席には別のお客様がいらっしゃいますね。飲み物を頼んだ時は、どちらに座っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are other customers in your previous seats now. Where were you sitting when you ordered the drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ前の席です。友人と二人で移り、飲み物は移動後にこちらで受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 注文時と受取時の席を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Still at the previous seat. My friend and I moved together and received the drink here after moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the order-time seat separately from the receipt-time seat in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 席番号と注文記録を照合します。隣のお客様の注文を移すのではなく、ご本人の追加分ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll compare seat numbers and order records. This is your own additional item, not moving the next customer's order, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。私の一杯だけです。隣の人の分まで払いたいという話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移す対象は自分の一杯だけだと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Just my one drink. I'm not saying I want to pay for the other person's items too.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear in Japanese that only your own one drink should be moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できました。この場面では追加一杯が旧席の記録に残っています。こちらへ移してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Confirmed. In this scenario, one additional drink remains on the old seat's record. May we transfer it here?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。前の伝票からも外れて、同じ一杯を二か所で請求しない状態を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新旧両伝票で二重請求を避ける訂正を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I'd like to check it's removed from the old bill too, so the same drink isn't charged in two places.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request in Japanese corrections to both old and new bills to avoid double charging.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方を訂正しました。こちらにはお二人の料理と追加一杯が入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've corrected both. This one includes the meals for both of you and one additional drink.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。その金額を払います。席を移した時点と注文した時点を分けて説明できてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正後の料理と飲料範囲を確認して払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked. I'll pay that amount. I'm glad I could explain the move time separately from the order time.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the corrected scope of food and drink and agree to pay in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。訂正した伝票で会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. We'll charge using the corrected bill.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰り注文のお受け取りですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you collecting a takeaway order?

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人の注文ですが、私が来たので、受取番号の名前を自分へ直した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 代理受取のため注文者名変更が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It's my friend's order, but since I'm here, should I change the name associated with the collection number to mine?
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether proxy collection requires changing the ordering person's name.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文者の記録を勝手に変えず、代理で来たことをお伝えください。番号は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than change the order record yourself, tell us you're collecting on their behalf. Do you know the number?

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号です。友人から受け取りを頼むメッセージもあります。料理を変更する依頼はありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号と依頼を示し変更権限はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-04.translation: This number. I also have a message from my friend asking me to collect it. They haven't asked me to change the food.
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the number and request and say in Japanese that you have no authority to change the order.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録と受け取り方法を確認します。支払いは済んでいると聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the record and collection method. Have you been told payment is complete?

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 済んだと聞きましたが、私には確認できません。メッセージだけで会計済みと言い切らず照合をお願いします。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 伝聞の支払済みを記録で照合してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was told that, but can't verify it myself. Please compare the record rather than let me assert payment is complete from the message alone.
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for reported payment completion to be checked against the record.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では支払い済みです。料理は二品ですので、内容もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this scenario, it is paid. There are two dishes; please check the contents too.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二品ですね。受け取ったら友人へ知らせます。注文者名を私に変えたと伝えることはしません。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 代理受領の二品を確認し注文者名は変えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two dishes, then. I'll tell my friend once I've collected them. I won't say I changed the ordering name to mine.
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm two dishes collected on another's behalf and say in Japanese that the ordering name stays unchanged.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 代理受取として確認しました。袋は一つでお渡しします。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've confirmed proxy collection. We'll hand over one bag.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。番号と二品を確認できたので、そのまま友人へ届けます。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した袋を注文者へ届けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. The number and two dishes are confirmed, so I'll deliver them to my friend as they are.
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will deliver the checked bag to the ordering person.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの袋です。料理を取り違えないよう番号もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the bag. Check the number too so you don't take the wrong food.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの椅子は空いていますか。

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が一時席を外しています。帰ったわけではないので、まだ二人で利用しています。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空椅子は一時離席で利用人数は二人だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-02.translation: My friend has stepped away briefly. They haven't left, so we're still using this as two people.
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the empty chair is due to a temporary absence and there are still two users.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。別のお客様へ椅子を移す前に確認しました。お戻りの予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. I checked before moving the chair for another customer. Do they plan to return?

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-04.sourceJa: すぐ戻る予定です。ただ、荷物を置けば席が正式に確保できると私が決めたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰還予定と自己判断の席確保を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-04.translation: They'll be back soon. But I haven't decided myself that leaving belongings means the seat is officially reserved.
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the planned return from reserving a seat on your own judgment in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では、お二人の利用として承っています。通路に置かれた荷物は足元へ移してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-05.translation: In this scenario, we have you down as two people. Please move the luggage in the passage to your feet.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。椅子の代わりに荷物で通路をふさがず、こちらへ寄せます。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物を通路から移すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll bring it over here rather than let belongings block the passage in place of the chair.
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will move the luggage out of the passage.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加の注文は、お戻りになってから一緒に伺いますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-07.translation: Shall we take additional orders together once your friend returns?

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうしてください。戻る前に二人分を私が勝手に追加するのでなく、友人と相談します。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加注文は同行者帰還後に相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I'll discuss with my friend rather than add orders for both of us myself before they return.
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to discuss additional ordering after your companion returns.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。今の注文は一人ずつで、追加はまだありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. The current order is one for each person, with no additions yet.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。利用は二人のまま、追加は保留ですね。友人にもその状態を伝えます。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定人数と未確定追加注文を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Still two people, and additions are on hold. I'll tell my friend that status too.
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the confirmed number of people separately from unconfirmed extra orders in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お戻りになりましたら、お声がけください。
DLG-SC-TKY-RES-002-SHARED-11.translation: Please call us when your friend returns.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは参拝のための列です。

DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お守りを受け取りたくて並びました。先へ進めば授与の窓口へつながると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参拝列を授与所へ続く列と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I joined because I wanted to receive an amulet. I thought going forward would lead to the amulet counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook the worship queue for a queue leading to the amulet office.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご用件の場所は別です。この列を横切らず、外側の通路へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: The place you need is separate. Please take the outer passage without crossing this queue.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。ここまで並んだ順番を、授与所へ移せるという意味ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列の移動で順番は移せないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. That doesn't mean I can transfer the place I've reached in this queue to the amulet office.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that moving to another queue does not transfer your turn.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。そちらの案内に従ってください。授与品のご希望は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Follow the guidance there. Have you decided which amulets you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 決まっていません。家族の分も欲しいのですが、先に案内を見てから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族分の種類は未決定で案内を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I'd like some for family too, but want to read the information before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the types for family are undecided and you want to see the guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 種類や扱いは授与所でお尋ねください。ここで家族の希望を推測して決める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ask the amulet office about types and handling. You don't need to guess your family's wishes and decide here.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家族へ候補を伝えます。返事が来るまで窓口を長く占有せず、外で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の返事を窓口外で確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll tell my family the options. Rather than occupy the counter for a long time until they reply, I'll check outside the counter area.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to check your family's reply away from the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通行を空けてご確認ください。参拝もされる場合は、その列へ改めてお並びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep passage clear while checking. If you also wish to worship, join that queue again separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は授与所の案内を見に行き、参拝の順番と混ぜずに動きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 授与と参拝の別の順番を守ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. For now I'll look at the amulet-office guidance and move without confusing it with my worship turn.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will respect the separate turns for amulets and worship.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 外側の通路はこちらです。各場所の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: The outer passage is here. Check the guidance at each place.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車前に、携帯は指定の場所へしまってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before boarding, put your phone in the designated storage place.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は撮らず、隣の友人に動画を撮ってもらう予定です。それなら持っていてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者が撮るなら携帯保持できるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I won't film; I planned to have my friend beside me record a video. In that case, may we hold a phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether a phone may be held if your companion films.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習場面では、乗車中はどなたも手に持って撮影しません。撮る人を交代しても同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this learning scenario, no one films holding a phone during the ride. Switching who films doesn't change that.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人の携帯も含めてしまいます。乗り物の外からなら撮れる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮影担当交代でも同条件だと理解し外の撮影場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. We'll put away my friend's phone too. Is there somewhere to photograph from outside the ride?
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge in Japanese that changing the camera operator does not change the rule and ask about an outside photo place.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 降りた後の指定エリアをご案内できます。他のお客様が映る範囲にも気を付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can show you the designated area after getting off. Also be careful about the area where other guests may appear.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこで二人の写真を撮りたいです。乗車中の記録を作るため、後で手を出して撮ることもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定場所で二人を撮り乗車中の撮影はしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to photograph the two of us there. I won't later hold a phone out to film during the ride to make a recording.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will photograph both of you in the designated area and will not film during the ride.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。保管場所に入れた携帯を、乗車中は取り出さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Do not take phones out of storage during the ride.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。取り出すのは降りて指定エリアへ移ってからですね。友人にも今説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯を出す時点と場所を友人へ共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. We take them out only after getting off and moving to the designated area, correct? I'll explain that to my friend now too.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Share in Japanese with your friend when and where phones may be taken out.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お二人とも準備できたら、係員にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once both of you are ready, please tell staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 伝えました。二台とも保管できたので、撮影をやめた状態で乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二台の保管を確認して乗車へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've told my friend. Both phones are stored now, so we'll board with filming stopped.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm both phones are stored and proceed to boarding in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認しました。乗車のご案内に従ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Confirmed. Follow the boarding instructions and proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 時間の案内についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the time information?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 演出が三時とあります。三時までに見ないと、像自体が見られなくなるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 演出開始を像展示の終了時刻か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says the special presentation is at three. If I don't see it by three, will the statue itself become unavailable to view?
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the presentation's start time is the end of the statue exhibition.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では演出の開始時刻です。展示そのものの案内とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this scenario, that is the presentation's start time. Information about the exhibit itself is separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら、静止した姿を見るだけなら、演出に間に合わせて走る必要はないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 静止姿を見る予定なら走る必要はないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then if I only plan to see it standing still, I don't need to run to make the presentation.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge in Japanese that you need not run if you plan to see the stationary statue.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。演出をご覧になるかで予定を考えられます。同行者とは何を見たいと話していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. You can plan according to whether you want the presentation. What have you discussed seeing with your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真を撮ることが目的です。演出の動画を撮る約束ではありません。混む時間を避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真目的と演出動画目的を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: Our purpose is taking photos. We haven't promised to film the presentation. We'd like to avoid busy times.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish a photo-taking purpose from filming the presentation in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影できる範囲と、その時の混雑を確認してください。空き場所を確保する予約ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check where photography is allowed and the crowd at the time. This isn't a reservation guaranteeing an empty spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。三時の場所を押さえるため荷物だけ残さず、友人と別の時間を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物で場所取りせず同行者と時間を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't leave only luggage to hold a place for three; I'll discuss another time with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not reserve space with luggage and will discuss timing with your companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 周囲の通行や他のお客様を妨げない位置でお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please enjoy it from a position that doesn't obstruct others' passage or visits.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。展示と演出の時間を分け、写真を撮る予定として友人へ案内を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 展示と演出を別々に確認して予定を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll distinguish exhibit and presentation times and pass the guidance to my friend as a plan for photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the exhibition and presentation separately and share the plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それぞれの案内をご確認ください。移動時も周囲にお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check each set of information. Be aware of your surroundings while moving too.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご到着予定は何日の何時でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: On what date and at what time do you expect to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十三日の午前一時です。十三日の一泊を予約したので、その時間から入れると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 深夜到着を同日一泊の開始と考えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: One a.m. on the thirteenth. I booked one night on the thirteenth, so thought I could enter from that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you treated an overnight arrival as the start of the same-date one-night booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の宿泊開始と、夜中の到着時刻は分けて確認しましょう。その前の晩から使いたいご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the booked stay's start separately from your middle-of-the-night arrival. Do you want to use it from the previous night?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。十二日の夜の続きとして寝たいです。十三日の昼まで待つ予定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前夜から休みたい希望時間を具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I want to sleep as part of the night of the twelfth. I don't intend to wait until daytime on the thirteenth.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify in Japanese that you want to rest from the previous night.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用を希望する時間に対応する予約があるか、担当が確認します。今の予約はまだ変更しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will check whether a booking covers your desired use times. We won't change the current reservation yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。日付が十三日だからと、その一泊で午前一時に入れるとは判断しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 暦の日付と予約の利用開始を分けて理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I won't assume that because the date is the thirteenth, that one-night booking lets me enter at one a.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese that you distinguish the calendar date from the reservation's usage start.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 到着予定を含めて確認します。同行者は同じ便で来られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check including your arrival plan. Will companions arrive on the same service?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人です。到着時刻だけを書き、人数や泊数まで別に増やしたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着情報の追加と人数泊数変更を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm alone. I only added my arrival time; I haven't additionally increased the number of guests or nights.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the added arrival information from changes to guest numbers or nights in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の予約と必要な利用時間、料金を照合してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll compare the present reservation, required use times and charges and explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。変更の内容と金額を聞いてから同意します。今の予約を先に取り消さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現予約を保持し変更内容と料金の説明後に判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll agree only after hearing the changes and amount. Please don't cancel the current reservation first.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to retain the present reservation and decide after an explanation of changes and charges.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。予約は保ったまま、時間に合う利用方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll keep the booking while checking an arrangement that fits your times.
